title: Amazon Passed Walmart. Then Kept Going.
source: Public market capitalization at approximate year-end/period close, per company stock data widely reported by financial press and market-cap trackers (YCharts, FinanceCharts, MarketCapHistory): Walmart ~$187B (2010), ~$244B (2013), ~$196B (2015), ~$279B (2018), ~$388B (2020), ~$378B (2022), ~$650B+ (2024). Amazon ~$81B (2010), ~$183B (2013), ~$317B (2015, the year Amazon's market cap first overtook Walmart's), ~$738B (2018), a pandemic-era peak near $1.63T (2020), ~$879B (the 2022 tech selloff low), and roughly $2T+ (2024).
